context_exposure.inherited_context: Parent task restrictions and shared execution defaults, user AGENTS instructions. No parent source or reports read before this proposal.
actual_reads: Evidence DESIGN_INTERFACE.md, task_materials.json, bundle.json, frames.json via cat
D2_summary.json via cat output partly truncated; no claim full rendered summary read
Both complete trajectory NPZ loaded using Pixi numpy and numerical summaries computed
prohibited_not_read: concrete dev/test states or model results

combination_consideration.adopted: P3 is exact P1+P2 combination, retaining independent P1/P2 ablations.
combination_consideration.reason: Current relation conditioning and future relation denoising address distinguishable parts of action learning and can share one network/budget.
combination_consideration.rejected_alternatives: Did not add hard grasp/contact routing or zero-distance terminal controller: D2 offers no failures, closure precedes measured lift by26/28 steps, and terminal head-goal x residual remains about0.064m. Did not force environment invariance because robot and gravity fixed.
combination_consideration.selection: Record and implement all three candidates; no outcome-based initial selection.

evidence_refs: demo_1_trajectory.npz: all78 observations and77 transitions; grasp closure step32, grasp height>0.05m step58
demo_2_trajectory.npz: all92 observations and91 transitions; closure step34, grasp height>0.05m step62

action_transform.encode: Native [world_dx,world_dy,world_dz,gripper] identity on all four physical control channels. xyz=1 requests0.01m at dt0.0125s; this is a command, not assumed realized displacement.
action_transform.decode: Read first4 output channels unchanged as native world control; apply world cube clipping[-1,1]^4 AFTER decoding. Auxiliary channels, if any, are discarded.
action_transform.chunk_frame: World axes fixed at replan and throughout all16 predictions; execute first4. No per-slot recentering.

candidates.augmentation: None. No whole-environment rotations/translations or label perturbations.

training_schedule.datasets: Each N in 2/5/10/20 starts from scratch seed0; statistics/targets use current nested D_N only.
training_schedule.optimizer: AdamW lr=1e-4 wd=1e-6 betas=(0.9,0.999), gradient_clip=1, EMA=0.995
training_schedule.window_sampling: Uniform CPU torch.randint over all current D_N transition starts; length16, zero padded tails excluded by validity mask.
training_schedule.diffusion: epsilon prediction, 100 cosine DDPM steps; DDIM16 leading integer timesteps [90,84,78,72,66,60,54,48,42,36,30,24,18,12,6,0], eta=0, no clean-sample clipping
training_schedule.aux_schedule: Auxiliary loss active at fixed declared weight for all updates; no pretraining or extra updates.

candidates.hierarchy_selection_and_termination: Single diffusion policy; no router, phase oracle, geometric action controller, predicted-success termination, or clock. Replan each4 actions until shared environment/horizon termination; episode clock unchanged.
candidates.chunk_transition_handling: Keep one conditioning two-observation history for complete16-action plan. No switching within chunk; execute4 then replan. Tail slots zero padded/masked during training. For auxiliary targets, all displacements use the observation at initial chunk anchor t.
candidates.required_runtime_inputs: Exactly two common raw42 observations, including pegHead and fixed goal. No images, future states, initial factors, hidden state, expert action, task-specific success signal, or auxiliary target at runtime.
candidates.parameter_budget: One shared U-Net, no separate experts; <=3x B0. Exact instantiated parameter counts must be audited before formal runs.
candidates.confidence: Moderate mechanism plausibility; low empirical certainty from exactly two positive-only trajectories. No performance has been measured.

knowledge_hypotheses.claim: A fixed-axis insertion has separate axial x travel and transverse yz alignment; relative hand/grasp and head/goal locations express these relations.
knowledge_hypotheses.source_ref: task_materials.json source_knowledge and supplied static-geometry attribution; no external implementation read.

knowledge_hypotheses.claim: The observed head is offset from the grasp site by approximately[-0.13,0,-0.01]m in both D2 episodes; grasp-hand offsets settle after lift.
knowledge_hypotheses.source_ref: Both trajectory NPZ; max deviation around mean head-grasp offset <=2.1e-7m.

knowledge_hypotheses.claim: Separating relative grasp and insertion geometry may reduce reliance on correlated initial peg_y/box_y in LL/HH and aid LH/HL compositions.
knowledge_hypotheses.source_ref: task_materials.json distribution plus two demonstrations only.

candidates.predicted_generalization_gain: Prospective: expose independent grasp and head-goal errors to improve recombination; fixed metric scaling may avoid small-D_N variance amplification.
candidates.applicability: Fixed observed insertion geometry and valid common physical pose channels; world gravity retained.
failure_conditions: Relative features still allow LL/HH shortcuts via retained raw fields.
No failure demonstrations teach recovery, and relational coordinates alone need not prevent early transport.
Fixed0.1m feature scaling may require larger feature extrapolation than trained trajectories.

architecture.backbone: Conditional temporal U-Net widths [64,128,256], time embedding128, kernel5, groups8, shared two-observation conditioning
architecture.trainable_parameter_cap: <=3 times identically measured B0; verify before formal runs
architecture.control: Every executed action is a sampled diffusion output decoded into native world xyz+gripper.

raw_retained.raw_fields: All42 common raw channels including observed peg head, with same two-observation history as B0.
raw_retained.units: World x,y,z positions in metres; quaternion xyzw; aperture unitless; prior/current raw channels unchanged.
raw_retained.normalization: Fixed scale1 for all raw fields, fixed zero center; passthrough all coordinates. No current or future dataset fitting.

observation_transform.axes: Native fixed world x insertion axis, world y lateral alignment, world z gravity. No rotation or translating the environment.
observation_transform.history: Apply deterministic feature map independently to each of the two raw observations, retaining their actual native previous fields; first observation repeated at reset.
observation_transform.normalization: All62 features passthrough downstream normalization; scaling above fixed from physical metric convention, not data-fitted.

action_epsilon.target: Independent standard Gaussian epsilon added to first4 encoded physical action coordinates under shared DDPM schedule
action_epsilon.reduction: Mean squared error over first4 channels and valid chunk slots only, averaged over batch
action_epsilon.applies: All sampled training windows, all updates

candidates.required_train_labels: Only demonstrated action chunks and validity masks; no added labels.
implementation_steps: Implement deterministic62D observation map with fixed normalization passthrough.
Keep4D identity world actions and shared diffusion.
Audit feature values, action round trip, valid-mask handling, parameter count.

action_epsilon.reduction: Mean squared error over first4 channels and valid chunk slots only, averaged over batch
action_epsilon.applies: All sampled training windows, all updates

future_relation_epsilon.target: Independent standard Gaussian epsilon used to noise six future relation channels under SAME sampled DDPM time as action channels
future_relation_epsilon.reduction: Mean squared error over six auxiliary channels and valid chunk slots only, averaged over batch
future_relation_epsilon.applies: All valid transition slots for every current-D_N training window; no loss on padded slots

losses_and_weights.total: action_epsilon_mean + 0.2*future_relation_epsilon_mean; no reconstruction, classifier, success, or terminal loss

future_relations.definition: For window start t and valid action slot k (0..15), target=[(head[t+k+1]-head[t])/0.1m, (grasp[t+k+1]-hand[t+k+1])/0.1m], native xyz each.
future_relations.data_source: Only observation rows of same current-D_N episode and anchor t. Terminal observation may supervise final valid transition. Never cross episodes.
future_relations.padding: Set all six targets to zero for slots t+k>=number of actions, exclude from loss using shared action validity mask.
future_relations.meaning: Observed realized head transport plus grasp relation; no labels assert success/contact or expert phase.

implementation_steps: Derive masked6D future targets using each current-D_N window only.
Append targets to encoded4D physical actions before diffusion noise; configure U-Net10 channels.
Keep base action loss first4 weight1 and add six-channel epsilon loss weight0.2.
Sample joint10 channels at runtime and discard auxiliary6 before physical world clipping.
Audit target anchoring, masking, action decode and parameter cap.
